# Call Prep

> The single call-planning capability for an Aleysian pursuit, with two modes.

**What it does.** Plan an Aleysian sales pursuit in two modes: maintain its canonical Pursuit Brief or prepare one upcoming call.

**Use it when.** For a pursuit overview, recommended call sequence, objective, attendee plan, agenda, tailored questions, talk track, negotiation preparation, or prospect, account, and competitor research before a sales conversation. Route post-call discovery and transcript ingestion to discovery-brief, scope and pricing to scoping-agent, and signed work to delivery skills.
